about: T-452 (2026-11-06): the redrawn roster in play, never seen until now. Twenty-two daemons, at least one from every batch (the pilot and 1-19) and every one the static audit flagged worst (back far smaller than the front, elevation kept from vanilla's table under a standing drawing, clipped at the frame, accents over the cap). For each: the lead's species set to it and the DEBUG ENCOUNTER page poked to it, INVOKE, so one battle shows its front (the foe) and its back (the lead) at 1x on the real ground; the battle won; then, once per batch, the lead walks Route 1 with it as the follower. Each INVOKE ends its own stop (the DEBUG step closes with B, which a battle swallows), the battle is the next. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved. The engine's current debug build, as built.
